findings.text: policy and workflow files, by path

internal/console/chat.go: t.poolPress runs before t.inThread(p.Conversation). If thread validation or lookup fails, the pool change has already landed, but the handler returns that unrelated error and skips the landed result and PR confirmation. Validate/bind the conversation before invoking the writer, while keeping both before t.open, and test that failed thread admission produces zero writes.

internal/console/writes_test.go: The outcome table checks len(infra.contents) before replay, then checks only the replay's 404 status. It never verifies PR/merge counts or rechecks writes after replay, so pending/repair replays could create another PR while these tests still pass. Assert commit, PR and merge deltas after the initial press and again after replay.
